paper_id: Review on Requirements Modeling and Analysis for Self-Adaptive Systems_ A Ten-Year Perspective
title: Review on Requirements Modeling and Analysis for Self-Adaptive Systems: A Ten-Year Perspective
motivation: 现有研究未系统总结自适应系统的建模方法和需求活动
problem_framing: 通过SLR系统综述2003-2013年间需求建模分析文献,提取方法分类与质量评估
key_insight: 企业模型应用更广泛,但行为模型评估更严格;需求驱动运行时适配是最频繁研究主题
method_signature: SLR覆盖21个 venues与8个数字图书馆,筛选109篇论文,提取29种建模方法8大类
evaluation_criteria: 10项质量评估问题(问题陈述/上下文/方法清晰度/评估详细度等)
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: no systematic study has been performed on summarizing modeling methods and corresponding requirements activities
evidence_for_taste: no systematic study has been performed
behavior models were more rigorously evaluated
requirements-driven runtime adaptation was the most frequently studied
thinking_moves: 用text mining从已知文献提取搜索词条,避免主观性
Kappa系数校准研究者间的理解差异
准灵敏度验证搜索策略的有效性
用准金标准建立搜索词条和评估自动化搜索性能
区分建模维度被考虑的程度与保障维度被传达的程度
